title: Visit DeeDee

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Long time since an Oogle came this far out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Long time since an Oogle came this far out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not an Oogle, Huckstash sent me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not an Oogle, Huckstash sent me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not an Oogle, Huckstash sent me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not an Oogle, Huckstash sent me.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Did he now? Well you can head straight back to the old ruin and tell him I have no interest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did he now? Well you can head straight back to the old ruin and tell him I have no interest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He gave me this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He gave me this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He gave me this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He gave me this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm investigating the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm investigating the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm investigating the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm investigating the Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You must have got your head stuck in a boom-tube and lost your hearing, I ain't interested!... what is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must have got your head stuck in a boom-tube and lost your hearing, I ain't interested!... what is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It seemed quite personal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It seemed quite personal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It seemed quite personal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It seemed quite personal.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You listened to it?? Fine I'll take it but only because I don't want my business being ogled by Oogles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You listened to it?? Fine I'll take it but only because I don't want my business being ogled by Oogles.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thought it best not to listen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thought it best not to listen.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thought it best not to listen.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thought it best not to listen.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: I appreciate that. I'll take it off your hands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate that. I'll take it off your hands.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Was that it? Are you just Huck's messenger tool?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was that it? Are you just Huck's messenger tool?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Fucking Huckstash. Never could keep his rice-hole closed. Listen I don't talk to cops anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking Huckstash. Never could keep his rice-hole closed. Listen I don't talk to cops anymore.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anymore?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anymore?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anymore?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anymore?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not a cop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not a cop.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not a cop.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not a cop.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Who do you work for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who do you work for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure. I'm being coerced into investigating something I'd rather avoid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure. I'm being coerced into investigating something I'd rather avoid.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure. I'm being coerced into investigating something I'd rather avoid.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure. I'm being coerced into investigating something I'd rather avoid.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: I mean, it sounds exactly like you're a cop...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, it sounds exactly like you're a cop...

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Spent 97% of my life running from cops, and the other 3% being ignored when I needed them. I don't talk to cops.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spent 97% of my life running from cops, and the other 3% being ignored when I needed them. I don't talk to cops.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huckstash mentioned you might have seen the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash mentioned you might have seen the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Huckstash mentioned you might have seen the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Huckstash mentioned you might have seen the Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Even if I had, why would I talk to you about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even if I had, why would I talk to you about it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hundreds of lives are in danger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hundreds of lives are in danger.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hundreds of lives are in danger.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hundreds of lives are in danger.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Hundreds? Only hundreds? What about the millions that will die at the hands of the corporations over the next century, crushed under the weight of their ancestors' debts until their eyes bulge from their faces? What about us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hundreds? Only hundreds? What about the millions that will die at the hands of the corporations over the next century, crushed under the weight of their ancestors' debts until their eyes bulge from their faces? What about us?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck them. I'm freelance. I need to know if you saw the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck them. I'm freelance. I need to know if you saw the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fuck them. I'm freelance. I need to know if you saw the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fuck them. I'm freelance. I need to know if you saw the Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If people paid their debts off they'd be fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If people paid their debts off they'd be fine.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If people paid their debts off they'd be fine.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If people paid their debts off they'd be fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does that have to do with a serial killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that have to do with a serial killer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does that have to do with a serial killer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does that have to do with a serial killer?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You Wallet-Walkers spend so much time living in the gutter that it becomes impossible to see the big picture. Why do you think The Aseptic does what they do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You Wallet-Walkers spend so much time living in the gutter that it becomes impossible to see the big picture. Why do you think The Aseptic does what they do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know. Nobody does.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Nobody does.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know. Nobody does.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know. Nobody does.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Oh you'd be surprised little Oogle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh you'd be surprised little Oogle.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you know?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you know?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enough of the games. People's lives are at stake.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enough of the games. People's lives are at stake.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Enough of the games. People's lives are at stake.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Enough of the games. People's lives are at stake.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: It doesn't matter who The Aseptic is, it matters what The Aseptic is. For the growing number of Aseptisists, the killer is a symbol. Man, Woman, Android, doesn't matter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It doesn't matter who The Aseptic is, it matters what The Aseptic is. For the growing number of Aseptisists, the killer is a symbol. Man, Woman, Android, doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aseptisists? This city really is messed up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aseptisists? This city really is messed up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aseptisists? This city really is messed up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aseptisists? This city really is messed up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Help me understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Help me understand.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Help me understand.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Help me understand.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Ever known CorpSec enforce a lockdown for a serial killer before now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ever known CorpSec enforce a lockdown for a serial killer before now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: CorpSec do their best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec do their best.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: CorpSec do their best.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: CorpSec do their best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess not.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess not.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess not.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Exactly! And as my great grandfather Leopold Kemp Jr. used to say 'Follow the Money'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly! And as my great grandfather Leopold Kemp Jr. used to say 'Follow the Money'.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think Aseptic is a Corpo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think Aseptic is a Corpo?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think Aseptic is a Corpo?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think Aseptic is a Corpo?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: No you little Oogle! The opposite. I haven't seen the Corpsters this scared in a long time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No you little Oogle! The opposite. I haven't seen the Corpsters this scared in a long time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But Aseptic only targets the poor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But Aseptic only targets the poor.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But Aseptic only targets the poor.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But Aseptic only targets the poor.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Exactly. What do the Corpsters fear more than death? Being broke. That's what Aseptic represents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. What do the Corpsters fear more than death? Being broke. That's what Aseptic represents.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think Aseptic is targeting the debt, not the people?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think Aseptic is targeting the debt, not the people?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think Aseptic is targeting the debt, not the people?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think Aseptic is targeting the debt, not the people?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Ever notice that all the victims are childless? Every time Aseptic takes one of us out, he or she or it ends the line of credit. Debt orphanism is the most profitable asset the Corpsters have.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ever notice that all the victims are childless? Every time Aseptic takes one of us out, he or she or it ends the line of credit. Debt orphanism is the most profitable asset the Corpsters have.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is absurd. He's a psychopath. Regardless of his motive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is absurd. He's a psychopath. Regardless of his motive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is absurd. He's a psychopath. Regardless of his motive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is absurd. He's a psychopath. Regardless of his motive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Makes a lot of sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Makes a lot of sense.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Makes a lot of sense.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Makes a lot of sense.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Look around you Oogle. The suffering that runs through the drains of Nivalis was not something invented by The Aseptic. It's older, more rotten. The Aseptic is a symptom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look around you Oogle. The suffering that runs through the drains of Nivalis was not something invented by The Aseptic. It's older, more rotten. The Aseptic is a symptom.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Even if you're right. They must be stopped.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even if you're right. They must be stopped.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Even if you're right. They must be stopped.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Even if you're right. They must be stopped.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Maybe. I can't see that happening until they want it to. The Aseptic wrote the rules of this game and we have to learn how to play.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. I can't see that happening until they want it to. The Aseptic wrote the rules of this game and we have to learn how to play.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I find it suspicious that you seem to know so much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I find it suspicious that you seem to know so much.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I find it suspicious that you seem to know so much.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I find it suspicious that you seem to know so much.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huckstash sent me here for a reason...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash sent me here for a reason...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Huckstash sent me here for a reason...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Huckstash sent me here for a reason...

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Because I saw The Aseptic. back when he was working the rails. I watched him doing his thing in a boxcar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because I saw The Aseptic. back when he was working the rails. I watched him doing his thing in a boxcar.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happened?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: I didn't see how he did it because I was wrapped in my sleep sack. I heard a voice in the dark. Assumed it was Fig-Wig, some random vagrant we'd picked up that week. Young lad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't see how he did it because I was wrapped in my sleep sack. I heard a voice in the dark. Assumed it was Fig-Wig, some random vagrant we'd picked up that week. Young lad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did you hear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did you hear?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did you hear?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did you hear?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: His voice... It sounded soft. He said 'You are the cure'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His voice... It sounded soft. He said 'You are the cure'.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That was it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That was it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That was it?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Yeah. That was it. I barely heard him leave. That's when I knew there had been a third person in that box car, Fig-Wig's body was still there. Never saw him coming.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. That was it. I barely heard him leave. That's when I knew there had been a third person in that box car, Fig-Wig's body was still there. Never saw him coming.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Suspicious that he spared you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suspicious that he spared you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Suspicious that he spared you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Suspicious that he spared you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds awful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds awful.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds awful.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds awful.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Back then, we... I had a kid, people with kids are no interest to The Aseptic, no opportunity to close the debt line.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Back then, we... I had a kid, people with kids are no interest to The Aseptic, no opportunity to close the debt line.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: You spend enough time on the rails you see stuff that's gonna get inside your bones. You do your best to bury it mostly but those words will live inside me until I take the last wind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You spend enough time on the rails you see stuff that's gonna get inside your bones. You do your best to bury it mostly but those words will live inside me until I take the last wind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You had a kid back then? Not now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You had a kid back then? Not now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You had a kid back then? Not now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You had a kid back then? Not now?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: While I remember, please give this to Huckstash. I recorded it a long time ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: While I remember, please give this to Huckstash. I recorded it a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you for your help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you for your help.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thank you for your help.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thank you for your help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about the people it affects? Do they agree to the plot? Hardly. They must be stopped.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about the people it affects? Do they agree to the plot? Hardly. They must be stopped.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What about the people it affects? Do they agree to the plot? Hardly. They must be stopped.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What about the people it affects? Do they agree to the plot? Hardly. They must be stopped.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Look at me Oogle. Really look at me. Do you think I'm sneaking off in the night and murdering the poor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look at me Oogle. Really look at me. Do you think I'm sneaking off in the night and murdering the poor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just don't leave town any time soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just don't leave town any time soon.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just don't leave town any time soon.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just don't leave town any time soon.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess not.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess not.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess not.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: Huckstash has his own agenda or maybe he's trying to throw you off the scent!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash has his own agenda or maybe he's trying to throw you off the scent!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think Huckstash could be the Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think Huckstash could be the Aseptic?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think Huckstash could be the Aseptic?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think Huckstash could be the Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: I'm just pulling your rope kid, Huckstash's knees gave out decades ago. If he were the Aseptic, he'd still be at the first crime scene.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just pulling your rope kid, Huckstash's knees gave out decades ago. If he were the Aseptic, he'd still be at the first crime scene.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why am I here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why am I here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why am I here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why am I here?

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: I ain't going anywhere but that has nothing to do with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I ain't going anywhere but that has nothing to do with you.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: I've seen a lot but I ain't got the shins for murder.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've seen a lot but I ain't got the shins for murder.

nodes.speaker: DeeDee
nodes.text: That's not a track we're going down Oogle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not a track we're going down Oogle.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I understand.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm investigating the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm investigating the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm investigating the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm investigating the Aseptic.
